# VictorySync

Victory Sync LLC provides US-managed contact center services with Cairo-based agents for appointment setting, cold calling, lead qualification, and inbound customer support.

## Services

- Inbound customer support and call answering
- Outbound appointment setting and lead follow-up
- Cold calling and lead qualification
- AI-assisted call summaries, CRM updates, routing, reminders, and reporting
- Digital marketing: SEO, Paid search, Paid social, Content marketing, Email marketing, Website and landing-page work, Analytics and reporting

## Who we work with

Home services, including plumbing and HVAC, real estate, legal, and SaaS businesses in the United States.

## Pricing

Service starts from $10 per agent hour. Final pricing depends on campaign scope.

## Launch time

Straightforward campaigns can often launch within 24 to 48 hours after scripts, lists, access, and escalation rules are approved.

## Hours

Monday to Friday, 9:00am to 6:00pm Eastern

## Partners

VictorySync is a Close CRM partner.
